reports.title: Mantle V2 Competitive Security Assessment (Secure3, March 2024)
reports.description: Secure3 private audit contest on Mantle V2 (Tectonic) covering the Mantle v1->v2 changes of mantle-v2 PR #72 (contracts-bedrock L1 and L2 directories plus the other changed contracts and offchain components) and of op-geth PR #20, at audit commits 00ce7b0 and be91998 with final commits 7040d02 and 64996df. It reports eight Critical findings, seven in the L1/L2 messengers, portal and ERC721 bridge (MNT-6 only acknowledged) and MNT-8 in op-geth core/state_transition.go.

versions.coverage: Directory explicitly in scope of the private Secure3 contest (together with the Mantle v1->v2 changes of PR #72) at the audit commit. Critical MNT-1, MNT-3, MNT-4, MNT-5, MNT-6, MNT-7 are located in L1CrossDomainMessenger, L1ERC721Bridge and OptimismPortal, and Critical MNT-2 names OptimismPortal and the L1 messenger reinitialization.

Fix PR #95 named in the client response for Critical MNT-7 (OptimismPortal revert check); only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-1, MNT-2, MNT-3, MNT-4, MNT-5, MNT-6.

Fix PR #98 named in the client responses for Critical MNT-5 and Medium MNT-32 (portal/messenger MNT handling); only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-1, MNT-2, MNT-3, MNT-4, MNT-6.

Fix PR #105 named in the client response for Medium MNT-35 (OptimismPortal l1mntSuccess default); only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-1, MNT-2, MNT-3, MNT-4, MNT-6.

Fix PR #109 named in the client response for Critical MNT-2 (relayMessage reentrancy on reinitialization); only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-1, MNT-3, MNT-4, MNT-6.

Fix PR #111 named in the client response for Medium MNT-18 (ResourceMetering reinitialization); only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-1, MNT-2, MNT-3, MNT-4, MNT-6.
Fix PR #103 named in the client responses for Critical MNT-3 and Medium MNT-12 (L1ERC721Bridge); only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-1, MNT-2, MNT-4, MNT-6.
Fix PR #110 named in the client responses for Critical MNT-1 and Medium MNT-33 (messenger value handling); only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-4, MNT-6.

Final commit of the contest after the client's remediation PRs; only the fixes were reviewed. MNT-4 is reported Fixed without a PR link and is treated as fixed here; MNT-6 was acknowledged only. Still open in this revision: MNT-6.

reports.title: Mantle_V2_Public Competitive Security Assessment (Secure3, April 2024 edition)
reports.description: Earlier (April 18, 2024) edition of the Secure3 public audit contest on Mantle V2, scoping the whole mantle-v2 and op-geth repositories at audit versions 7040d02 and 64996df with final versions d8efd33 and 641584e. It reports five Critical findings, MNT-2, MNT-4 and MNT-5 in the contracts-bedrock messengers and ERC721 bridge and MNT-1 and MNT-3 in op-geth core/state_transition.go and core/vm/evm.go.

versions.coverage: The whole mantle-v2 and op-geth repositories were in scope of the public contest at the audit version; the contracts-bedrock Solidity tree is recorded as a whole, other paths only where the report locates Critical findings. Critical MNT-2 (L1/L2CrossDomainMessenger), MNT-4 (L1CrossDomainMessenger, acknowledged) and MNT-5 (L1ERC721Bridge) are located here.

Fix PR #120 named in the client responses for Medium MNT-16 and MNT-21 (baseGas hashing cost), based on the audit version; only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-2, MNT-4, MNT-5.

Report's final version: the head of PR #128, one commit on top of the audit version (MNT-18 / N-01 boolean fix); it does not contain fix PRs #120, #123 and #127. Still open in this revision: MNT-2, MNT-4, MNT-5.

Fix PR #127 named in the client response for Critical MNT-5 (L1ERC721Bridge cannot receive ERC721), based on the audit version; only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-2, MNT-4.

Fix PR #123 named in the client response for Critical MNT-2 (messengers calling MNT/BVM_ETH), based on the audit version; only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-4, MNT-5.

Fix PR #146 on release/v1.0.0 named in the client response for Medium MNT-14 (relay reserved gas); it also contains PRs #120, #123, #127 and #128; only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-4.

The whole op-geth repository was in scope of the public contest at the audit version; this offchain file is recorded because the report locates acknowledged Critical MNT-1 (gasUsed called before gasRemaining is scaled) in it.
Report's final op-geth version (head of fix PR #67, which also contains PRs #43 and #62). Still open in this revision: MNT-1.

The whole op-geth repository was in scope of the public contest at the audit version; this offchain file is recorded because the report locates acknowledged Critical MNT-3 (call depth attack with a large block gas limit) in it.
Report's final op-geth version (head of fix PR #67, which also contains PRs #43 and #62). Still open in this revision: MNT-3.

reports.title: Mantle_V2_Public Competitive Security Assessment (Secure3, May 2024 final edition)
reports.description: Final (May 10, 2024) edition of the Secure3 public audit contest on Mantle V2, scoping the whole mantle-v2 and op-geth repositories at audit versions 7040d02 and 64996df with final versions d8efd33 and 641584e, now listing declined submissions and several downgraded severities. It reports four Critical findings, MNT-4 in L1ERC721Bridge, the declined MNT-1 in the legacy v1 L1CrossDomainMessenger, the declined MNT-3 in op-chain-ops migration code and MNT-2 in op-geth core/state_transition.go.

versions.coverage: The whole mantle-v2 and op-geth repositories were in scope of the public contest at the audit version; the contracts-bedrock Solidity tree is recorded as a whole, other paths only where the report locates Critical findings. Critical MNT-4 (L1ERC721Bridge) is located here.

Fix PR #120 named in the client responses for Medium MNT-25 and MNT-31 (baseGas hashing cost), based on the audit version; only the fix was reviewed. Critical findings not fixed at this PR head: MNT-4.
Report's final version: the head of PR #128, one commit on top of the audit version (MNT-18 / N-01 boolean fix); it does not contain fix PRs #120, #123 and #127. Still open in this revision: MNT-4.
Fix PR #127 named in the client response for Critical MNT-4 (L1ERC721Bridge cannot receive ERC721), based on the audit version; only the fix was reviewed.
Fix PR #146 on release/v1.0.0 named in the client response for Medium MNT-22 (relay reserved gas); it also contains PRs #120, #127 and #128; only the fix was reviewed.

Legacy Mantle v1 messenger; the whole repository was in scope, and this file is recorded because the report locates Critical MNT-1 (no unpause function) in it. The client declined the finding, stating that packages/contracts is unused.
Report's final version; the declined finding was not fixed. Still open in this revision: MNT-1.

One-time offchain migration code; the whole repository was in scope, and this file is recorded because the report locates Critical MNT-3 (legacy withdrawals relayable twice) in it. The client declined the finding.
Report's final version; the declined finding was not fixed. Still open in this revision: MNT-3.
The client responses to MNT-8 and MNT-12 state that contracts-periphery is out of the audit scope; the submissions there were declined.

The whole op-geth repository was in scope of the public contest at the audit version; this offchain file is recorded because the report locates Critical MNT-2 (sponsor logical flaw, fixed per the client response in PRs #62 and #43) in it.
Report's final op-geth version (head of fix PR #67, which also contains PRs #43 and #62).
